Subject: Azure private offer — next steps & merchant acceptance

Hi Karthik / Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Alpha Health wants to move forward with a private offer on Azure Marketplace so we can centralize purchasing and use our Microsoft credits. Procurement asked for two items before they can issue a PO: 1) a merchant acceptance confirmation from Microsoft that Redwood will be listed under our private plan, and 2) a short SOW that maps usage tiers to estimated monthly spend for our finance team.

Attached is a draft SOW (v1) and the vendor onboarding form Microsoft sent over. Can you confirm who from Redwood will sign the SOW and whether we need to submit any additional documents to the Azure team? We also need the final pricing rows (per-token / embedding rates) for the private offer.

Can we aim to have the merchant confirmation and SOW back to us by Thursday so procurement can route the PO?

Thanks,
Sanjay Patel
VP, Procurement
Alpha Health

Hi Sanjay / team,

Thanks — attached is SOW_v2 (clean + tracking of changes). I adjusted the pricing section into three tiers based on their projected usage: Starter (<=2M tokens), Growth (2M-8M), and Enterprise (>8M). For the private offer pricing I'm proposing:
- Starter: $0.0012 / token
- Growth: $0.0009 / token
- Enterprise: $0.0007 / token
Embeddings: $0.65 / 1k vectors (flat)

These are aligned with what Finance signaled for co-sell-eligible customers. If Alpha wants a steeper enterprise discount we can consider a one-time onboarding credit instead of lowering the ongoing rate.

I can sign the SOW on Redwood's behalf for statement-of-work acceptance. For merchant acceptance, we will need Microsoft to confirm the private offer is owned by Alpha Health and that the listing will be visible only to their tenant — I'll loop the MP contact.

Attachment: AlphaHealth_SOW_v2.docx

Marissa Cole
Sr. Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference

From: mp-marketplace@microsoft.com

Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 13:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Merchant acceptance request — private offers

Hello Redwood team,

Thanks for the submission. For merchant acceptance we need the following to proceed:
1) Private Offer Package (pricing rows, entitlement SKU name, unit of measure)
2) Proof of reseller/merchant relationship OR confirmation that the private offer is customer-owned (Alpha Health tenant will control the purchase)
3) Copy of the signed SOW or confirmation that Redwood will receive a PO linked to the private offer

Once we receive the package we'll process the merchant acceptance and issue a confirmation email that Alpha Health can submit to their procurement. Typical processing time is 48-72 hours. See attached instructions.

Regards,
Microsoft Marketplace Operations
Attachment: Azure_PrivateOffer_Instructions.txt

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Sanjay / Marketplace Ops / team — quick status update and next steps.

1) SOW: Marissa signed the revised SOW (v2) on behalf of Redwood. Attached is the PDF redline and clean copy for your records. We will accept the PO and link it to the private offer once merchant acceptance is complete.
2) Pricing / Package: Marissa's tiered pricing table is final (Starter / Growth / Enterprise). SKU name: RDW-ALPHA-PRIVATE-2027. Unit: tokens (per-token) and vectors (per-1k). See attached package.
3) Merchant acceptance: Microsoft — please confirm merchant acceptance for Alpha Health (customer-owned private offer). If you can issue the confirmation email to both Kar thik and Sanjay it will unblock procurement.

Procurement asked whether Redwood will accept a PO referencing the private offer and whether Redwood will invoice Alpha Health directly or Microsoft will handle invoicing via marketplace. Ben — can you confirm preferred invoicing path and whether we need an invoice routing clause in the SOW?

Target timeline: Microsoft confirmation by end-of-day Tuesday 20th, PO issued Wed 21st, activation by Thurs 22nd. If that timeline is tight we should escalate to MS partner manager.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachment: MSA_redline_20270718.pdf
